stories.headline: Fire at Czech drone facility investigated as terrorism after anti-Israel group claims responsibility
stories.summary: A fire at LPP Holding's warehouse in Pardubice, which manufactures drones for Ukraine, is being investigated as suspected terrorism. An unknown group called 'Earthquake Faction' claimed responsibility, citing the facility's alleged ties to Israeli defense contractor Elbit Systems.

stories.headline: Lockheed Martin finalizes F-35 industrial cooperation agreements with Czech Republic
stories.summary: Lockheed Martin completed all 11 industrial cooperation project agreements for the Czech F-35 Lightning II program, with production of 24 aircraft expected to begin in 2027. The agreements will create jobs over the next 50-60 years.

stories.headline: Czech Republic supports EU initiative to ban Russian military from Schengen area
stories.summary: Czech Republic joined other EU countries supporting stricter visa rules for former and current Russian military personnel participating in the war against Ukraine, advocating for enhanced restrictions on their entry to the Schengen zone.

articles.title: Czech Republic supports the initiative to ban Russian military from entering the EU

stories.headline: Concerns raised over potential 'foreign agent' legislation targeting NGOs
stories.summary: Opposition parties and NGOs are criticizing the Czech government for allegedly preparing Russia-style legislation that would tighten disclosure rules on foreign financing of civil society organizations, creating a database of NGOs with foreign ties.
